answer: Clawback vesting at the vine: rewards vest over 30 days, so a sybil cluster's payout is revocable until settlement. Nadir detection flags payout concentration, freezing funds before withdrawal. The bridge between identity creation and cash-out stays open only for honest operators; each fake identity costs 30 days of locked stake, and a farm of 50 loses all vesting at once when flagged. Delayed payout converts cheap sybil creation into expensive locked capital. This works because attackers must front real stake for a month while detection tools have full visibility to unwind it.
